up: Identify all compounds mentioned in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4513141. For each compound, return its ChEMBL ID, preferred name, and canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON cr.doc_id = d.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON md.molregno = cr.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON cs.molregno = md.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4513141';
